profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, that runs school gardens and farms and offers environmental and nutrition education at public schools in the East Bay. It also works on greening schoolyards, planting trees, and increasing access to fresh food for school communities.

review.notes: ProPublica lists Growing Together Bay Area Inc (EIN 88-2293022, Oakland, 501(c)(3)); the About page names OUSD among four districts served and the contact page confirms phone, generic email and address. The summary matches the About page and OUSD's garden/nutrition enrichment agreement titles; 'nutrition education' is only loosely stated on the About page (fresh food access) but is consistent with the agreement titles.
